scope: Three unfinished fresh reviews stopped. Partial summaries are not completed verdicts; no uncommitted child review artifacts were imported.

tasks.partial_summary: R2’s seven vector edits and name-set hashes check out. Its cap arithmetic also matches the original limits. The remaining finding is the closed-contract mismatch with the concurrent capsule. Future transport, R8, and COPYv4 implementations remain open proof gates; their absence alone is not a defect.

I found a definite schema error: the future consumer maps the basis name to the guard reference, and the guard name to the basis reference. Correct four-file pins cannot pass that mapping. I also found a failure path that can emit zero observations, while the capture schema requires at least one.

The independent reader confirms 9 path literal changes in each component, 35 in the driver plus the two allowed globals, and exactly 8 schema constant changes. All three patches reproduce the source bytes, and full reverse restoration recovers the old sources. Both manifests validate: C1 retains 9 payload rows; C2 covers all 19 payload files.
